name: VetCheck
tagline: AI Veterinary Clinical Management & Telehealth SaaS
problem: Veterinary practices across the UK and Australia required unified, high-availability practice management with zero-downtime releases and rapid response times during busy clinic hours.
solution: Engineered an automated Blue/Green deployment pipeline on AWS using Laravel Octane, FrankenPHP, and centralized ElastiCache (Redis/ValKey), ensuring sub-100ms consultation response times and seamless rollouts without customer disruption.
metrics: Multi-Region UK & AU • Zero-Downtime Deployments • Sub-100ms Response Times

name: AjakMe
tagline: Modern Digital Wedding Invitation & Guest RSVP SaaS
problem: Couples needed an elegant, zero-stress way to design digital invitations, track guest RSVPs in real time, generate physical print-ready card exports, and automate WhatsApp communications.
solution: Built a touch-optimized, zero-cognitive-load Livewire 3 + Alpine.js single-page application with automated high-resolution PDF print exports, dynamic QR check-ins, and guest communication funnels.
metrics: Production Live • Automated WhatsApp Notifications • Print-Ready PDF Generator

name: ACCEA Membership & Room Booking
tagline: Unified Identity, SSO & Flexible Room Reservation Platform
problem: Enterprise coworking centers needed a single unified identity provider across multiple web properties along with real-time room scheduling to eliminate double bookings.
solution: Architected a centralized Single Sign-On (SSO) OAuth2 identity provider and connected reservation engine with concurrency-safe booking calendars, payment gateways, and automated member access.
metrics: Unified Single Sign-On • Real-Time Concurrency Calendar • Enterprise Multi-Location

name: altHR (Digi-X)
problem: Malaysian enterprises required a centralized digital workforce platform managing employee leaves, automated payroll, time tracking, and staff perks at scale.
solution: Contributed to high-volume microservice APIs, payroll calculations, and scalable mobile backend endpoints supporting tens of thousands of corporate employees across Malaysia.
metrics: High-Volume Enterprise Scale • Microservices Architecture • Fintech & Payroll Integration
